An APHIS inspector arrived at Mattersville (Site 003) to conduct an unannounced inspection. When the inspector
commented on the exposed dig barrier fencing and sharp points on the ground that the wolf-hybrids were walking on in
the first two enclosures, Mr. Roberston became verbally aggressive, stating that he was extremely mad and would not
continue “the fucking inspection.” He said that he would call someone else. He walked away while cursing and the
inspector heard him raising his voice on the phone. When Mr. Robertson returned, he walked past the inspector and
slammed the gate behind him. Over the closed gate, he stated that the other employees would not return to the facility for
at least an hour but that he was “fucking done.” He repeatedly raised his voice, used profanity, and expressed anger
about unannounced inspections. Mr. Robertson repeatedly stated how mad he was about APHIS’ “nit-picky”
unannounced inspections. During this interaction, Mr. Robertson’s behavior continued to escalate. He was pacing with his
shoulders hunched and his fists clenched, his voice remained raised, and he used profanity and the f-word throughout.
Given Mr. Robertson’s level of agitation and his continued use of profanity, the inspector informed him that she was
leaving the facility without completing the inspection.
When licensees interfere with, verbally abuse, or harass an APHIS official in the course of carrying out their duties, it
prevents APHIS from inspecting the licensee’s facility, animals, and records to ensure compliance with the Animal
Welfare Act and Regulation.
A licensee or applicant for an initial license shall not interfere with, threaten, abuse (including verbally abuse), or harass
any APHIS official in the course of carrying out his or her duties.
No exit interview was conducted.
